title: State-OPD: State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
abstract_first: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring reasoning capabilities from frontier models to smaller models, while extending its success to multi-turn agentic environments remains challenging.
